# LinkedIn Marketing API Program Access Tiers

Warning

**Deprecation Notice:** The Marketing Version 202601 (Marketing January 2026) will be sunset on January 15, 2027. We recommend that you migrate to the latest [versioned APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/versioning?view=li-lms-2026-09) to avoid disruptions. For information on all the supported versions, refer to the [migrations](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/migrations?view=li-lms-2026-09#api-migration-status) documentation. If you haven’t yet migrated and have questions, submit a request on the [LinkedIn Developer Support Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/ask/dsapi).

LinkedIn has two tiers of access to our Advertising API: Development and Standard.

The tier assigned to your app defines how many [Ad Accounts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/ads/account-structure/create-and-manage-accounts?view=li-lms-2026-09) you can manage through the APIs. Upgrade to the next access tier by meeting the requirements described for that next level. Please note that all API Calls at all access levels are made on production data. Also, use of LinkedIn's Campaign Management APIs is subject to our [LinkedIn Marketing API Program Terms](https://business.linkedin.com/marketing-solutions/marketing-partners/become-a-partner/marketing-developer-program/terms-and-conditions).

Access to the Advertising API is reserved for applications building supported use cases. See the [Advertising API Overview](https://developer.linkedin.com/product-catalog/marketing/advertising-api) for more information on supported use cases.

| Tier | Description |
|---|---|
| Development | Build end-to-end workflows. |
| Standard | Support campaign management for multiple accounts. |

## API Access Tier Details

The following table outlines number of Ad Accounts you have access to and minimum qualification requirements for each access tier.

| Access Tier | API Access Granted | How do you get access?* |
|---|---|---|
| Development | - **Read:** No limits on reading data related to Ad Accounts you administer - **Create** : Access to create 1 test Ad Account through the API. All real Ad Accounts must be created through the Campaign Manager tool in this tier. - **Edit** : Make updates related to up to 5 ad accounts that you administer | Visit your app's Product tab in the [Developer Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) to apply for the Advertising API. |
| Standard | - **Read** : No limits on reading data related to Ad Accounts you administer - **Create** : Create unlimited Ad Accounts - **Edit** : Make unlimited updates related to Ad Accounts that you administer | Click on View Ad Accounts setting for the Advertising API under Added products within the [Developer Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps). |

* LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion and a partner might not be upgraded even if they meet these minimum requirements.

## Development Access

Visit your app's Product tab in the [Developer Portal](https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps) to apply for the Advertising API product.

Before accessing the Standard Access tier, you must first build and test your application on LinkedIn’s advertising platform.

Open to qualified developers, so you can build end-to-end workflows before obtaining full permissions. This tier enables you to POST for up to 5 Ad Accounts and GET for an unlimited number of accounts. To set up the ad account list, see [Managing Your Ad Accounts List](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/getting-started?view=li-lms-2026-09#managing-your-ad-accounts-list) in Getting Started.

## Standard Access

Standard Tier is designed for heavy ad demands with no limit on number of ad accounts.

LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion and a partner might not be upgraded even if they meet these minimum requirements.
